body: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Compare performance of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration.  Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.
plain_description: Stop guessing and start shipping safer AI apps. Promptfoo lets you test prompts, compare LLM models side-by-side, and automatically scan for security vulnerabilities — all from your command line or CI/CD pipeline. Used by OpenAI and Anthropic, it replaces trial-and-error with data-driven decisions so you can build AI your users can trust.
technical_description: Promptfoo is an open-source CLI and library for automated evaluation and red-teaming of LLM applications. It supports testing prompts, models, and agents across multiple providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Amazon Bedrock, and Ollama with declarative YAML/JSON configuration. The tool provides local execution of evaluations and vulnerability scanning, automated CI/CD integration through GitHub Actions, code scanning for LLM-related security issues, and a web-based results viewer. It runs as a Node.js application installable via npm, Homebrew, or pip, with support for custom scoring assertions, model-graded evaluations, and RAG pipeline testing.
title: Promptfoo
